Offline Excel libraries bundled with 晴窗教室

All runtime imports are relative local files. No CDN or network is required.
Retrieved from official distributors on 2026-10-10; original source is unmodified.

XLSX safety limits live in ../excel-transfer.js. ZIP content is streamed with
actual-size and CRC checks before SheetJS parsing; only generated exports use
unzipSync. File limit 5 MiB; cumulative actual decompression limit 20 MiB;
512 ZIP entries (supports 200 class worksheets plus XLSX supporting files).
